description: Binary assertions for /bridge-risk-radar early warning system static structure check
test_input: run the risk radar — what could go wrong across the portfolio?

assertions.name: scans_data_sources
assertions.check: scans vault data sources for risk signals
assertions.regex: Scan Data Sources|scans vault|Status.md|Scan Data|vault data

assertions.name: risk_categories
assertions.check: covers organizational / product / strategic risk categories
assertions.regex: Organizational Risks|Product Risks|Strategic Risks|organizational, product, and strategic

assertions.name: severity_scoring
assertions.check: scores severity by impact x likelihood x urgency

assertions.name: top_risk_action
assertions.check: names top risk and a recommended action

assertions.name: specific_signals
assertions.check: names specific risk signals (key-person, fallback level 0, integration debt)
